context: The SQLite backend must be substitutable behind the existing engine layer; TypeScript structural typing alone fails once a class has private members.
rationale: Pure extraction — every interface mirrors its class verbatim — shipped as a zero-behavior-change release so the full suite pins the refactor before the new backend lands.
summary: Extract storage interfaces (src/storage/interfaces.ts) and type engines against them, because private fields make the concrete class types nominal
